data.title: Fine notice (Bußgeldbescheid) for a speeding violation – €147.00 total
data.summary: The Landkreis Musterammerland Bußgeldstelle issued a fine notice to Fenja Musterwolde for driving 18 km/h over the 30 km/h speed limit near a primary school in Beispielstede on 23 September 2026. The total amount due is €147.00 (fine €115.00, fee €28.50, delivery costs €3.50), and 1 point is recorded in the Fahreignungsregister; the notice was delivered by Postzustellungsurkunde on 23 November 2026.
data.explanation: This is an official fine (Bußgeldbescheid) for a traffic violation. You can accept it and pay, or you may object (Einspruch) in writing or in person at the Bußgeldstelle within the period shown by the app, which starts from the day the letter was officially delivered. If you do nothing, the fine becomes legally final and the €147.00 must be paid within two weeks after that happens; unpaid fines can lead to enforcement action. Because a point is also recorded in the driving register, you may want to check with a traffic-law advisor if you are unsure whether to object.

date.text: Die Frist von zwei Wochen beginnt mit dem Tag der Zustellung.

items.action: Decide whether to file an objection (Einspruch) against the fine notice, in writing or in person at the Bußgeldstelle, before the deadline shown.
items.consequence: If you do not object in time, the fine notice becomes legally final (rechtskräftig) and enforceable.

date.text: Der Gesamtbetrag ist zwei Wochen nach Eintritt der Rechtskraft zu zahlen.

items.action: Pay the total amount of €147.00 to the account shown within two weeks after the notice becomes legally final, i.e. after the objection period ends without an appeal having been filed.
items.consequence: Late or missed payment can lead to enforcement measures (Vollstreckung).
